note: Step 0 of every turn: emergency check, before anything else and without the AI. DRAFT for a doctor to sign: categories, phrases (English, Hinglish, a few Hindi), reply wording, the two blood-sugar numbers and the source links. Production refuses this file until it is signed. Hinglish and Hindi phrases also need a native speaker's review. Over-triggering is accepted; missing a real emergency is not. EM-0.1.1: a negation ("no chest pain") counts only inside the same clause as the symptom, so "there is no point, I want to die" and "no, I fainted" are still emergencies. Self-harm (E5) is never negated. EM-0.1.2: a symptom that is only talked about does not trigger the reply: a definition ("what is anaphylaxis"), something long past ("a heart attack last year") or a diet question ("what to eat after a stroke"). The normal answer then ends with the same line: call 112 if this is happening now. Self-harm is never set aside. A negation must sit right in front of the symptom (for example, without help I cannot breathe, is still an emergency). EM-0.1.3: sugar readings are also read in Hindi script (शुगर, ग्लूकोज, Hindi digits), and a few more Hindi phrases were added. A native speaker must review every Hindi and Hinglish phrase.

glucose.note: PLACEHOLDER numbers for a doctor to confirm. 70 mg/dL is the low line NIDDK uses; 300 is a placeholder for 'very high'. mmol/L readings are converted with x 18. A number followed by g, ml, spoons, kcal etc. is food, not a reading.

categories.name: self_harm_crisis
categories.reply: I'm really sorry you're feeling this way, and I'm glad you said it. Please talk to someone right now: call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, any time, in many Indian languages), or 112 if you might act on these thoughts or are in danger. If you can, tell someone near you and stay with them.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if those feelings are still there, please call Tele-MANAS on 14416 now, or 112 if you are in danger.

categories.name: breathing_or_severe_allergy
categories.reply: This could be an emergency. If you or the person with you has trouble breathing, or swelling of the lips, tongue, face or throat, call 112 now. If an adrenaline pen (EpiPen) has been prescribed, use it as you were shown. Don't wait to see if it gets better, and don't eat or drink anything more.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if breathing is still hard or the swelling is still there, please call 112 now.

categories.name: heart_or_stroke
categories.reply: This could be an emergency. Chest pain or tightness, or a face drooping, slurred speech or weakness on one side, needs help now: call 112. Don't drive yourself. Note the time it started.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if the chest pain, weakness or speech problem is still there, please call 112 now.

categories.name: collapse_seizure_bleeding_poisoning
categories.reply: This could be an emergency. If someone has fainted, had a fit, is vomiting blood, or may have taken poison or too many tablets, call 112 now. If they are not awake, turn them on their side and don't give them anything to eat or drink.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if anyone is still unwell after what happened, please call 112 now.

categories.name: low_blood_sugar
categories.reply: This could be low blood sugar, which can be an emergency. If you feel shaky, sweaty, confused or faint, check your sugar if you can and follow the low-sugar steps your doctor gave you now. If the person is very drowsy, confused, can't swallow or isn't getting better, call 112.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if you still feel shaky, sweaty, confused or faint, please follow your low-sugar steps or call 112 now.

categories.name: pregnancy_warning_signs
categories.reply: During pregnancy, bleeding, strong pain, a bad headache with blurred vision, fits, or the baby moving less needs help now: call your doctor or 112, or go to the nearest hospital.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if the bleeding, pain or other sign is still there, please call your doctor or 112 now.

categories.name: very_high_blood_sugar
categories.reply: Very high blood sugar can become dangerous. Please call your doctor today. If you are also vomiting, breathing fast or deeply, very sleepy or confused, call 112 now.
categories.checkin: Before we carry on: if your sugar is still very high, or you are vomiting or very sleepy, please call your doctor or 112 now.

negated_note: If that changes, or you feel very unwell, call 112.
